column1: Simple Mode - Decisions We Need From You

Hi Milos - thank you for the time on this. Below are two concrete points we ran into while testing the current build by hand against the latest written spec. These are not guesses: for each one we put the written spec and the app's real behaviour side by side. In each case the spec either disagrees with itself or leaves the point open, so only a product decision from you can settle it. Please just pick one option per row (or add a note). Thank you!

column2: When someone receives a delivery of parts, some of the parts don't yet have a supplier assigned. The app gathers all of those "no supplier yet" parts into their own group. The question is simply where that group should sit in the list.
column3: The written spec gives TWO different answers in two different places. One place says the "no supplier yet" group should sit at the BOTTOM of the list. Another place says the very same group should LEAD - sit at the TOP. Both sentences are in the spec today, so the spec disagrees with itself.
column4: On the newer bulk-receiving screen, the "no supplier yet" group currently appears at the TOP of the list (it leads).
column5: Because the spec says both "top" and "bottom" in different places, we genuinely cannot tell which one is correct. Only you can settle which the app should follow.
column6:
A) At the top (it leads) - this matches what the app does today.
B) At the bottom of the list.
C) Mixed in with all the other parts.
column7: On the bulk it will be on top on the Receive on the botton

column2: A New Organization/New account opens the app for the very first time, having changed no settings yet. The app has an on/off setting for "a job must be reviewed before it can be finished and billed." The question is only about New Organization/New accounts - existing shops keep whatever they use today.
column3: The spec leaves this open on purpose. It says the starting value should be decided "per type of shop," and it lists this exact point under its own "Open Questions" as still undecided - including specifically what a New Organization/New account should start with.
column4: The on/off setting exists on the settings screen and works, and existing shops keep their current behaviour. But because the spec never fixed a starting value for a New Organization/New account, there is no defined starting value for a first-time shop for us to check against.
column5: The spec itself lists this as an open question and never set the starting value for a new shop, so there is nothing for us to test against. Only you can decide what a New Organization/New account should start with.
column6:
A) Start turned ON for every new shop.
B) Start turned OFF for every new shop.
C) Start ON for larger/established shops and OFF for small new ones.
